basic_info.description: Stunning ocean view in the highly desirable Central Parkside Neighborhood. Large 2,848 sq ft lot, Fully-renovated, 3-side detached modern beauty with . Custom design features 4-bedroom and 4-bath with excellent interior layout at both levels. Boasting exceptional natural light with skylights, designer details, and a well-thought out floor plan. As you enter the front entrance, you are greeted by a grand, high-ceiling foyer. The kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring state-of-the-art appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large center island which serves as the centerpiece of the house. This master bathroom is a true retreat, spacious, luxurious, beautifully designed, with excellent ocean view. The sleek, modern fixtures create a serene atmosphere, while the oversized soaking tub and walk-in rain shower offers the perfect space to unwind. With soft lighting and thoughtful interior design, it feels more like a spa than a bathroom. The French door leads to a comfortable redwood patio in the backyard. Walking distance to local businesses, public transportation, and Ocean Beach. Excellent schools and recreation parks nearby. Easy access to freeways.
